What you need to know
Over-ear headphones with Cloud Foam earcups for ultimate comfort
Smart Active Noise Canceling blocks external noise for immersive listening
Up to 70+ hours battery life keeps your music going between charges
Noise-cancelling microphones deliver clear calls
Audio Performance & Sound Quality
40mm drivers provide depth and clarity for a rich, immersive audio experience
Spatial Audio is compatible with Dolby Atmos, Tempest 3D AudioTech and Windows Sonic
Bluetooth LE Audio delivers high-quality wireless sound
Noise Control
Smart Active Noise Canceling learns and adapts to cancel distractions up to 25dB
Be Aware mode stays connected to your environment for safety and awareness
Fit, Comfort & Design
Form-Fit earcups are shaped for ergonomic fit and natural outline of the ear
1-inch Cloud Foam cushions and adjustable hinges ensure custom comfort
Foldable design and rotating earcups offer easy storage and portability
Earcup buttons let you control functions and customize settings in the JLab App
Battery Life & Charging
70+ hours of playtime (40+ with ANC on) for uninterrupted listening
2.5-hour charge time from empty to full
Calls & Microphones
Built-in noise-cancelling microphones ensure clear and reliable call quality
Echo reduction creates uninterrupted conversation
Connectivity & Smart Features
Bluetooth Multipoint connects and switches between two devices simultaneously
Google Fast Pair enables quick Bluetooth connection with compatible Android devices
Google Find My Device assists in locating your headphones
Wireless Share Mode lets you share audio wirelessly between two Lux headphones
The JLab App enables sound and ANC customization, safe hearing volume limits, and software updates
Durability
240g lightweight design feels comfortable for extended wear
